evidence: RULE 1: a MEASURED offset must exist as its OWN ROW. Recording a measurement inside another row's evidence prose does not reach the resolver. Rows starting with # are skipped by jlc_rotation_resolve.py.

RULE 2 (2026-07-25, THE CORRECTION BELOW): NEVER populate a row from jlc_twin's jlc_offset. Derive it from the BOARD + JLC's cached model with an operator VERIFIED against pcbnew itself (pad.GetFPRelativePosition() vs pad.GetPosition()). jlc_twin.xform() used the wrong handedness, so every offset it reported was NEGATED: invisible at 0/180 (sign-invariant) and exactly 180deg wrong at 90/270. Six rows here were populated from it and were all 180deg wrong. Checker and checked must not share a method (canon M1).

RULE 3 (2026-07-25, canon A-POL): the `polarity` column is a REQUIRED DECLARATION, one of n/a | two-channel | single-channel. A pad-NUMBER fit structurally CANNOT detect a model whose own numbering differs from ours, and a HIGH FIT MARGIN IS NOT CONFIDENCE: on usb-hub-3s-v3's indicator LEDs (C2296/C2297) the pad-number fit returns 180 with a 17.7x margin and is WRONG — JLC numbers pad 1 = ANODE while KiCad Device:LED is pin 1 = K, both libraries draw the cathode WEST, so the true offset is 0 and a 180 row would ship every indicator dark (indistinguishable from a bad joint). two-channel = a NUMBERING-FREE channel (silk chamfer, pin-1 dot/glyph, mounting-tab position, body/courtyard asymmetry, lead axis) is RECORDED IN THIS ROW. single-channel = no such channel exists; the row MUST name the JLC order-preview human gate, which then carries it before first order. Graded by jlc_rotation_audit.py --table.

Ours numbers pad 1 = the CENTRE RF pin with pads 2-5 = the four ground posts; JLC numbers pad 5 = the centre with pads 1-4 = the posts. That is the C3020560 USB-C class, where a numbered fit pairs our signal pads against their shell posts. THE NUMBERING-FREE PAD CLOUD (pads grouped into size classes ranked by area, each of our pads matched to the nearest of the paired class, no pad number read) measures rms 0.0000mm at ALL FOUR ANGLES -- 1.0x, fully degenerate -- because the land is four posts on a 5.08mm square plus one pin on the axis, which is its own 90-degree rotation. WHAT DECIDES IT IS THAT THERE IS NOTHING TO DECIDE, and that is a measurement, made on three independent things. (1) PADS: our own land's pad set (positions and sizes, no numbers) maps onto itself at 90, 180 AND 270 degrees, and so does JLC's. (2) GRAPHICS: every graphic primitive of OUR land maps onto itself at 90, 180 and 270 as well -- the 6.5mm F.Fab body square, the F.Fab insulator circle on the origin, the four 0.9mm F.Fab post squares spanning 2.09..2.99mm in each quadrant, and the four F.SilkS corner brackets at +-3.900. Our land carries NO asymmetric feature of any kind, so there is no mark for a mark-to-mark channel to match and no orientation our own copper is able to express. JLC's land has exactly ONE asymmetric graphic, an F.SilkS pin-1 dot of r=0.030 at (-3.25,+3.25); a pin-1 dot FOLLOWS pad numbering so it is not admissible, and it has no counterpart on our side to be matched against in any case. (3) NETS: on the board, pad 1 of all ten refs carries the RF signal (ANT1-ANT7, RX1_MAIN, RX2_OUT) and sits ON the rotation axis, while pads 2-5 are all GND -- so a 90-degree turn permutes the ground posts among themselves and leaves the netlist IDENTICAL. All four candidate angles are therefore the SAME PHYSICAL PLACEMENT: the machine cannot misorient this part, and 0 is correct by measured symmetry rather than by fit. THIS ROW DOES NOT REQUIRE THE ORDER-PREVIEW HUMAN GATE -- a human at the preview would have nothing to confirm, and routing a part that has no orientation to a human gate is how a gate teaches its operators to wave rows through (the failure the C2762192 tool-gap note warns about). CONTRAST, on this same board, with C5121458, which is ALSO cloud-degenerate at all four angles and IS declared single-channel: there the degeneracy hides a real 90-degree error because its 24 pads carry 24 different nets. Here the degeneracy is the absence of the question.
